subject: ela
cluster: Range of reading and level of text complexity
intro: When we read together, we listen, look at the pages, and think about the story. Reading with a purpose means we read to find out something, like what happens or who is in the story. Kindergartners take part and show they understand.

items.prompt:
Read.

The little hen looked for help, but no one would come. So she did the work herself.

What is this story mostly about?

steps: I think about the whole story.
A hen looked for help, got none, and did it herself.
So it is mostly about a hen who does the work on her own.
solution.answer: A hen who does the work by herself.

items.prompt: Before reading a book called 'The Lost Puppy,' what do you think it will be about?

steps: I use the title to guess.
The title says a lost puppy.
So I think it will be about a puppy that gets lost.

items.prompt:
Read.

The ant worked all summer to store food. The grasshopper played. In winter, the ant had food and the grasshopper did not.

Who was ready for winter?

steps: I read to find out who was ready.
The ant stored food all summer.
So the ant was ready for winter.

items.prompt: A book is called 'My Day at the Zoo.' What will it be about?

steps: The title tells me: a day at the zoo.

items.prompt:
Read.

The boy shared his lunch with a hungry friend.

What kind thing did the boy do?

steps: He shared his lunch, which is kind.

items.prompt: When we read together, we should ____ to the story.
